ground_truth.description: The added tests only cover the idle-drain path where drain() emits the marker synchronously. The coupled active-loops path — where drain() is called while a project loop is still running (flag stays False, no emit) and the run_loop drain block must emit 'Harness fully drained' exactly once after loops finish and stay silent thereafter — is untested, despite being the primary path the one-shot flag was introduced to guard.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
